subtitle: 學校該禁止還是開放學生在課堂上用手機？
task: Some schools ban mobile phones in the classroom, while others let students use them for learning. Which policy do you think is better? Explain your opinion with reasons and examples.
taskZh: 有些學校禁止學生在教室使用手機，有些則讓學生用手機學習。你認為哪一種做法比較好？請用理由和例子說明你的看法。
focus: 立場清楚，並承認反方觀點再回應
段落之間用 Moreover、However 等連接詞銜接

en: Many schools are now deciding whether students should be allowed to use phones in class. In my opinion, phones should be banned during lessons, except when a teacher asks students to use them for a specific task.

The main reason is that phones are a constant distraction. Even when students plan to look something up, a single notification can pull them into social media or games. I have seen classmates miss important explanations because they were checking messages under their desks.
Moreover, a ban helps students build better relationships. Without phones, they are more likely to talk to each other during group work and pay attention to the teacher.
Of course, phones can be useful learning tools, for example for quick quizzes or online dictionaries. However, teachers can still allow them for these activities and collect them afterwards.
Overall, I believe a clear rule with a few exceptions is the best way to keep classes focused.
zh: 現在許多學校都在考慮是否該讓學生在課堂上使用手機。我認為上課時應該禁止使用手機，除非老師要求學生用手機完成特定的任務。
主要原因是手機會不斷讓人分心。即使學生原本只是想查個資料，一則通知就可能把他們拉進社群媒體或遊戲裡。我就看過同學因為在桌子底下看訊息，而錯過重要的講解。
此外，禁用手機有助於學生建立更好的人際關係。沒有手機，他們在分組活動時更可能彼此交談，也更專心聽老師講課。
當然，手機也可以是很好用的學習工具，例如用來做小測驗或查線上字典。不過，老師仍然可以在這些活動時開放使用，結束後再收回來。
整體而言，我認為訂一條清楚的規定、再保留少數例外，是讓課堂保持專注的最好方法。
